title: feat(plugin-form): an undeclared form dialog spreads a field-heavy form to three columns, four in a full dialog
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBU5y97XtBcJ8qSLSR3B3Djd)_
Fixes #34607
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgwLiKcfujYUug7sPs

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：表单弹窗在作者没写 `columns` 时，不再固定 2 列：字段多（9 个以上）的表单在标准弹窗里排 3 列，在 `full` 弹窗里（16 个以上字段）排 4 列；窄屏仍 1 列。分组、对象字段分组同样处理。
- **为什么改**：维护者原话「目前默认只有两列字段，对于复杂的业务表单，宽屏时候非常浪费」。xl 弹窗的字段区实测宽 61rem，已过 4 列断点（56rem），所以标准弹窗封顶 3 列、放大（full）才到 4 列，正好对上验收「xl 弹窗 3 列，放大后 4 列」。
- **风险与回滚**：只动弹窗；整页、向导、分页签表单输出不变（有对照测试）。作者显式写了 `columns`（含 `1`）的照写。回滚即 revert 本 PR。HotCRM 很多表单显式写了 `columns: 2`，所以在去掉这些声明之前 HotCRM 看不到变化（本 PR 不碰 hotcrm）。附件（file / image）在本 PR 里仍占一格：改成独占整行要动共享的 `WIDE_FIELD_TYPES`，会连带改变整页、抽屉和详情布局，与「不改整页表单的现有推断」冲突，席位已把这个问题提交维护者。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/autoLayout.ts` 的 `dialogUndeclaredColumns`（封顶规则）；`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx` 的 `effectiveModalSize` / `undeclaredColumns` 两段（尺寸先算、列数后算，不循环）；`__tests__/dialogContainerColumns-34607.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/dialogContainerColumns-34607.test.tsx`，预期 14 个用例全部通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

A form dialog whose author declared no `columns` drew every form two per row. It now takes its count from `dialogUndeclaredColumns(fieldCount, modalSize)` (new, dialog-only, in `autoLayout.ts`):

- `inferColumns` of the fields the dialog lays out, **at least 2** (the old fixed default, so a form of up to eight fields draws exactly what it drew before);
- **at most 3** in a bounded dialog, **4 only in a `full` one**. Measured, not assumed: the `xl` dialog is `sm:max-w-5xl` (64rem) and its `@container` scroller pads `sm:px-6`, so the field container is 61rem wide, over the `@4xl` tier (56rem). A literal `containerGridColsFor(4)` would therefore draw four columns in `xl`, against acceptance 1 (「xl 弹窗里是 3 列」). The size cap is what makes the acceptance true.

The count reaches all three dialog arms: the flat form (fed to `applyAutoLayout` through the explicit-columns route), the object's `fieldGroups` fallback (derived groups no longer stamp a fixed `columns`; the arm reads the form's declared count, else the dialog's), and authored sections (`sectionedGridLayout` takes a new optional third argument, `undeclared`).

Dialog-only, per the claim's corrected premise: `UNDECLARED_SECTION_COLUMNS`, and the defaults of `sectionColumnsFor`, `sectionedFormColumns` and `sectionedGridLayout`, are unchanged. The three functions gained an optional trailing `undeclared` parameter defaulting to that constant; `ObjectForm`, `TabbedForm` and `WizardForm` do not pass it. None of the touched symbols is in the package's published entries (`index.tsx`, `core.ts`), so the public surface is byte-unchanged.

Card items:

1. Undeclared dialog grid follows the container tiers: done, with the size cap above.
2. Size inference allows `xl` for field-heavy forms: already true on `main`, and unchanged. The size reads the declared grid or the floor of 2, never the count it then bounds, so there is no cycle. Proof: an undeclared grid is at least 2 either way, so `inferModalSize(min(grid, inferColumns(n)))` gives the same answer as before for every input.
3. Wide kinds at 4 columns: textarea, rich text, markdown, html and inline `grid` take the whole row at every tier (pinned at 4 columns). **Attachments (`file` / `image`) stay one cell in this PR.** They are not in the shared `WIDE_FIELD_TYPES`, and adding them there would also change page, drawer and detail layouts, which conflicts with 「不改整页表单的现有推断」. No code changes for them here. The seat is taking that question to the maintainer (claim amendment 6938698182).
4. A declared `columns` is drawn as written: pinned for `2` and `1`, on the form and on a section.

Maximize / full-page toggle is #34604. Acceptance 1's 「放大后是 4 列」 is shown under the existing authored `modalSize: 'full'`.

### Before / after (sixteen undeclared fields, fields per row at `@md` / `@2xl` / `@4xl`; below `@md` always 1)

| Surface | `main` (97defd60) | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| dialog, inferred `xl` | 2 / 2 / 2 | 2 / 3 / 3 |
| dialog, `modalSize: 'full'` | 2 / 2 / 2 | 2 / 3 / 4 |
| dialog, declared `columns: 2` | 2 / 2 / 2 | 2 / 2 / 2 |
| dialog, five fields | 2 / 2 / 2 | 2 / 2 / 2 |
| `ObjectForm` sectioned page, undeclared | 2 / 2 / 2 | 2 / 2 / 2 |

## Tests

- New `__tests__/dialogContainerColumns-34607.test.tsx` (14 cases) covers acceptance 1 (xl, full, phone, wide kinds at 4), acceptance 2 (declared 2 and 1, a declared section beside an undeclared one), undeclared sections and `fieldGroups`, the light-form floor, and the page controls: `ObjectForm` sectioned and flat, plus `sectionedGridLayout` with no third argument.
- Pins moved, with reason (acceptance 3):
  - `dialogDefaultLayout-12521.test.tsx`: its twelve-field fixture (`inferColumns` gives 3) now draws the three-wide grid. Four expectations moved from the 2-wide grid and `@md:col-span-2` to the 3-wide grid and `['@md:col-span-2', '@2xl:col-span-3']`. The phone-column check now reads "every multi-column tier is a container query" in place of "every tier is `@md`". Size, authored-layout and light-form pins are unchanged.
  - `undeclaredSectionDensity-12592.test.tsx`: in the page-host case "every section undeclared", the byte-equality with the dialog is replaced. The page still reads 2 / 2 / 2 (unchanged), and the dialog reference now reads 2 / 3 / 3. The light `MIXED` case still matches the dialog byte for byte.
  - `mixedSectionColumns-12548`, `sectionColumns.test.tsx`, `modalFieldGroups.test.tsx`, `autoLayout.test.ts`, `modalViewportGutter-12593`, and app-shell `AppContent.recordDialogInterimBound-12521` / `AppContent.formViewModalSize-12803` needed no change; all of them pass as they are.

## Acceptance notes

- Card item 3, attachments: `file` / `image` stay one cell in this PR, in the dialog and on the page alike. Making them wide in the shared `WIDE_FIELD_TYPES` would change page, drawer and detail layouts, which conflicts with 「不改整页表单的现有推断」. The seat is taking that question to the maintainer.
- `ui/packages/plugin-form/README.md` § "Column width of a sectioned form" was stale: it said an undeclared sectioned form "is single-column". It now names the page hosts' default (2 per row) and the dialog's own undeclared count (2 to 3 by field count, 4 in a `full` dialog). It also says that a declared `columns` is drawn as written. The file was added to the surface by claim amendment 6938698182; this was fix round 1.
- HotCRM declares `columns: 2` on many forms, so HotCRM shows no change until those declarations go. hotcrm is not touched.

## Verification

Local gates follow the `dispatch-gates --commands` list derived for this diff; readings are in the report comment. Browser check: NOT MEASURED (jsdom evaluates no container query). The tier claim rests on the class reading in the tests plus the 64rem − 3rem = 61rem ≥ 56rem arithmetic above.
